title: Looking for a Butterfly/Bug Catching Net

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Tile/Icon/Sprite, really doesn't matter - trying to frankensprite my character to swing a net.
Maker Format:
MZ
Makers I Own:
XP,Ace,MV, MZ
Art Style:
I'm really not picky. Ideally I'd love for it to look good with
Plue's
Fantasy World, but I'll take what I can get and make it work.
Description:
I'd like to have my character catch some lightning bugs, butterflies, and maybe even fairies in my game ~ but I can't find a net I can use. I've googled rpg maker bug net and butterfly net and such, but I've only found sprites of butterflies and mentions of Paint.net (cause 'net') and nothing I can actually use. I've no artistic skills to make anything even half decent, all I can do is simple edits of sprites and such.
Any help would be greatly appreciated, thank you.

posts.author: The_Eerie_One
posts.body: First and last bump. I just need a net for a sprite to hold. I feel like this should be a somewhat common resource, but due to the word "net" having other uses it's just so difficult to find.

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I think people need to know exact size to make a pixel art.
There are lots of net artworks on the internet if you search, but maybe most of them are a way too big, need to pay, or are of the wrong style.
Since you mentioned franken sprite, maybe you can find an icon set thread on this site and edit them for your own use, if their terms allow it.
If you are using 48x48 characters, icon sized picture should fit them well. You just need a circle, a pole, and a net bag. Let me think, maybe a modified version of a hand mirror + a pointy hat + a weapon handle?
